biggest_catch: Student-only: you must open with an email address ending in .edu and attend a college, university, or trade school within the 31 counties OSCU serves in Oregon and Washington. No direct deposit required, but you must complete 10 qualifying transactions within 60 days.
catches: Open a new checking account using your student email address ending in .edu; you must be a student at a college, university, or trade school within the 31 counties OSCU serves in Oregon and Washington.
Not eligible: members under 18, businesses, trusts, or members with an existing checking account or who had a checking account within the previous 12 months.
Complete 10 qualifying transactions within 60 days of opening (debit card or mobile wallet purchases, bill pay, or Pay It Now money transfers).
$300 is deposited into your Basic Savings account no later than the last day of the 4th calendar month after account opening.
A Basic Savings account comes free with every OSCU membership.
